audit.whatIsWrong: The lane is read as 'chip her down', but her defensive scaling inverts that.
audit.why: Steadfast Presence passively grants armour and magic resist that INCREASES the lower her health gets, so poking her without finishing her makes the follow-up trade worse for you, not better.
audit.corrected: Chip does not soften her — Steadfast Presence gives more armour and MR the lower she drops, so poke to take plates, not to set up a kill you can't close.

audit.whatIsWrong: The W anti-dash rule is stated without its cooldown, which is the whole timing.
audit.why: Steadfast Presence is 20/18/16/14/12s — at rank 1 that is a twenty-second window where Heroic Swing works normally. Heroic Charge is 14/13/12/11/10s and Keeper's Verdict 140/120/100s.
audit.corrected: Steadfast Presence is 20s at rank 1 — once it's spent you get a full twenty seconds where your swing is a real engage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Keeper's Verdict's grounding and channel, and Iron Ambassador's buckler, never reach the page.
audit.why: Keeper's Verdict grounds and knocks back — grounded, Heroic Swing will not fire at all, so her R denies your escape as hard as her W does. Poppy is also untargetable during that channel, so a Comeuppance spent into it is wasted. Iron Ambassador drops a buckler she picks up for a free shield, and you can walk over it to deny the pickup.
audit.corrected: Keeper's Verdict grounds you and she's untargetable while channelling; deny her Iron Ambassador buckler by standing on it.

edits.before: Poppy's window: she outscales your lethality into raw tank stats, her E can pin you to a wall for the stun, and her R knockback boots you out of every fight you try to skirmish.
edits.after: Poppy's window: she outscales your lethality, Heroic Charge pins you to a wall for the stun, and Keeper's Verdict grounds you — no swing fires — before knocking you out of the fight.

edits.before: Poke her with Q Avengerang on her short-range walk-ups and proc your third-stack shield before she closes the gap
edits.after: Poke her walk-ups with Avengerang and step on her Iron Ambassador buckler so she never picks up the free shield

edits.before: Confirm her W (Steadfast Presence) is down before you commit a Heroic Swing, or it negates the dash and leaves you stranded next to her
edits.after: Confirm Steadfast Presence (20s at rank 1) is down before you commit a Heroic Swing, or it negates the dash and leaves you stranded beside her

edits.before: Negate your Heroic Swing with Steadfast Presence so your E becomes a dead escape, not a kite
edits.after: Negate your Heroic Swing with Steadfast Presence, or ground it outright with Keeper's Verdict

edits.before: Youmuu's spikes your Q kite, but Steadfast Presence still negates your Heroic Swing, so your first-item snowball is capped, not unleashed.
edits.after: Youmuu's spikes your Q kite, but Steadfast Presence still negates your Heroic Swing every 20s, so your first-item snowball is capped, not unleashed.

edits.before: She outscales your lethality into raw tank stats, her E pins you to a wall for the stun, and her R boots you out of fights — you simply can't kill her late.
edits.after: She outscales your lethality into raw tank stats that grow as she drops, Heroic Charge pins you to a wall, and Keeper's Verdict grounds you out of the fight.

edits.before: You fall off and she takes over. Your lethality stops mattering once she finishes tank items — you can chip but you can't kill, while she only needs one E into a wall to stun-lock you and delete you in that window. Her R knockback ejects you from every fight you try to peel in, and her W shuts off the Heroic Swing you'd use to escape. Your only path is the lead you built in the 2-6 window: end the game on the back of early Q poke, R picks, and roams, because a full-build Poppy with her anti-dash W is the worst possible scaler for a squishy lethality skirmisher.
edits.after: You fall off and she takes over. Your lethality stops mattering once she finishes tank items — worse, Steadfast Presence hands her more armour and MR the lower she gets, so chipping her without closing makes the next trade harder. One Heroic Charge into a wall stun-locks you, Keeper's Verdict grounds your swing before it ejects you, and she is untargetable through that channel. Your only path is the lead you built in the 2-6 window: end the game on the back of early Q poke, R picks, and Going Rogue roams, because a full-build Poppy with an anti-dash W is the worst possible scaler for a squishy lethality skirmisher.

notes: Steadfast Presence scaling its resists UP as her health drops was missing and it reverses the natural 'poke him low' instinct. Keeper's Verdict grounds — that matters more to Akshan than the knockback, because grounded means Heroic Swing does not fire at all. UNVERIFIED: spikes[1], mid and whys[4] state Comeuppance scales 'up to 200%' with missing HP; that number is not in the kit file, so those strings were left untouched.
